items.title: Repeated sync calls discard fractional lender credits
items.description: An outsider can erase less than one lamport per lender touch; material aggregate harm beyond the disclosed rounding policy remains unverified.

gate_evidence.1: ALLOWS: SyncLender market/PDA/owner bindings at sync_lender.rs:74-94 validate a real victim; owner.is_signer selects touch_pot at118-126. The no-rebase postcondition130-132 does not block a current-epoch touch. pool.rs:1474-1488 floors and advances snapshots.
gate_evidence.2: ALLOWS: current lenders and small positive index deltas exist without a forged record; the numeric example stays within integer bounds.
gate_evidence.3: ALLOWS: owner is UncheckedAccount, and the unsigned branch is explicitly public. No signature of the victim is needed.
gate_evidence.4: DEMOTE: each extra touch discards less than one lamport per accumulator. No scalable material loss is established in this scan; no current finding is inferred merely from repetition.

items.known_issue_comparison: KI-68; docs/design/ECONOMICS.md:1422 explicitly describes current/parked per-touch rounding.
items.code_smells: per-touch floor; snapshots advance without a lender remainder

items.title: Authority changes accept a successor without its signature
items.description: An honest governance transfer can install an unusable key, so further configuration changes require a program upgrade.

gate_evidence.1: ALLOWS: canonical ApplyConfig AccountLoader and timelock/expiry checks apply_config.rs:35-81 authenticate the stored proposal, not successor control. ProposeConfig requires old governance at19-25. check_authorities config.rs:769-795 only checks nonzero/distinct keys. The real config PDA can be proposed without forging its signature.
gate_evidence.2: ALLOWS: an otherwise valid Authorities proposal can name the config PDA and apply during its normal timelock window. No invalid account bytes or malicious upgrade are required.
gate_evidence.3: ALLOWS under honest-admin hazard: the currently authorized admin makes one bad-key transfer; any caller executes the valid stored proposal. This is not a claim that a malicious trusted admin is an outsider.
gate_evidence.4: ALLOWS bounded control loss: the config PDA cannot satisfy future governance Signer checks through an available program path. Old governance cannot reverse it, but the retained upgrade authority can recover via upgrade; user exits remain. Not permanent loss without recovery.

items.title: Exit instructions omit the position status check
items.description: A future instruction that persists a non-open status needs matching exit checks; current writers only create open positions.

gate_evidence.1: UNCERTAIN for hypothetical future status: the exit Accounts structs bind real position PDA, market and borrower but omit status, unlike add_margin. Runtime ownership/discriminator and Anchor close prevent forging/reviving current state.
gate_evidence.2: BLOCKS present exploit: state/position.rs:19-21 reserves status1 forv1.1; open_short.rs:616 writes only POSITION_OPEN; both reviewers searched current writers. Retain mandatory hardening LEAD.

items.title: Temporary withdrawals change live settlement inputs
items.description: An LP changes live settlement inputs with temporary withdrawals; the current arming sequence, borrower loss, and net payoff remain unverified.

gate_evidence.1: UNCERTAIN: genuine keyed venue reserves enter arming::inputs208-216. CR uses the floor223, box corners239 and persistence guards remain; this review has not reconstructed a transaction sequence that passes all corners and timers.
gate_evidence.2: UNCERTAIN: an LP can change real reserves, but the required honest state outside the box and complete subsequent observations are not independently produced here.

gate_evidence.4: DEMOTE: arming.rs40-50 describes accepted cases including no borrower loss at defaults; new current borrower loss and profitability are unverified.

items.title: Wrapped observations can preserve a low liquidity estimate
items.description: An LP can preserve a low liquidity history; the current observation sequence and forced-liquidation payoff remain unverified.

gate_evidence.1: UNCERTAIN: liquidate::assess356-368 uses max live/guarded EMA via spot_liquidity and also checks robust spot and persistent EMA entries. A direct same-transaction drain is blocked; the claimed held-history sequence is a different path but not fully reconstructed.
gate_evidence.2: UNCERTAIN: a genuinely held withdrawal can lower the EMA; the full restore/wrapped-observation sequence remains unproved in this pass.
gate_evidence.3: ALLOWS conditionally: an ordinary LP owns the liquidity it removes and restores.
gate_evidence.4: DEMOTE: no independent current payoff or borrower-loss calculation beyond the disclosed FITX-1 source statement.

items.title: The last withdrawal leaves carry for the next lender
items.description: A new lender collects up to 18,446 lamports of earlier carry in the traced initial-deposit cases because the last withdrawal preserves both remainders.

gate_evidence.1: ALLOWS: Deposit/Withdraw signer and PDA/mint/token bindings validate genuine owners and accounts. create_market.rs658-661 initializes zero shares, swept bits and hold=-1; no list-only lending cap. deposit129-154 accrues, sees empty vest and satisfied bits. withdraw194-213 permits B=0, flushes vest via pool.rs1897-1904, burnsS, and claims0; zero shares clear only sweep bits1908-1911. A zero sweep restores the trader bit without altering carry. The next valid deposit/sweep/fullwithdraw pays the old carry through normal claim and rent-backed pay_sol. Failed min_sol would roll back; old owner uses its legitimate zero minimum.
gate_evidence.2: ALLOWS: A=10^18 or18e18 rawtokens fitsu64; S=1000A fitsu128. Initialized ordinary SPL mint without freeze authority is admitted. List-only market needs no open position or venue trade. Actual third-party SOL donation supplies backing; unmatched stays0. Source trace identifies each normal state write and uses no forged counters.
gate_evidence.3: ALLOWS: prior lender signs its normal full exit; the later lender signs only its own deposit/withdraw and uses public sweeps. An unrelated income payer supplies the old credit, so the transfer is not limited to attacker self-harm.
gate_evidence.4: ALLOWS bounded loss: 999 and17,999lamports of earlier income become spendable by a different owner after the prior account closes. The demonstrated amount exceeds one-lamport rounding, but is tiny and bounded by18446lamports in the initial-deposit construction; higher-ratio reachability/profit is not claimed. Treat as low-magnitude accounting transfer, not broad theft.

items.title: Small donations can extend a settlement hold
items.description: An attacker extends a held vest with small sweeps; the exact settlement setup and a fix that preserves historical rewards remain unverified.

gate_evidence.1: UNCERTAIN: deposit130-135 requires zero vest for a held market; sol_settle324-328 arms it; public sweep and pool::vest_in965-986 permit weighted extensions before expiry. True source bits are assumed and achievable, but full settlement-to-hold trace remains partial.
gate_evidence.2: UNCERTAIN: a legitimate held vest is reachable; the specific1000000lamport starting settlement was not constructed. Arithmetic verifies47→48/450seconds and then1→2/10800seconds without an expiry race.
gate_evidence.3: ALLOWS: any payer can donate1lamport and call sweep_trader against genuine market accounts. No victim signature needed.
gate_evidence.4: DEMOTE: deposits can remain unavailable while attacker continues, but claims/withdrawals/exits stay available; final withdrawal/fullwipe flushes. Source and findings.md72-89 explicitly allow later credits to extend the hold. The cheap sustained extension needs liveness triage and a safe accounting design, not deletion of the historical-reward guard.

items.known_issue_comparison: AIR2-04/05 documentation already states extensions prolong deposits; this low-cost repeated schedule is additional detail. AIR-02 weighted-end rounding is related but a different old defect.
items.code_smells: the shared vest gates deposits; public sweeps renew the vest
